status: candidate physical scales: range, velocity and lateral are accepted working conversions; no recovered firmware constants
development_data: 0000016d segment 10; fixed matched wire ID19/HUD ID2; offset is a median alignment to nominal HUD positions. Velocity zero observed on stationary persistent tracks in segment 0.
physical_scale_evidence: 5 cm/count distance, 0.1 m/s/count velocity and 0.01 m/count lateral are accepted working conversions. Lateral was 1/128 m/count until 2026-09-28; gyro yaw kinematics, camera lateral and consistency with the 2^-12 rad azimuth field replaced it.
range_field: Range is 48:12 (accepted 2026-09-28 on held-out routes); bits 60-63 are the object class. dRel = 0.05*raw12 - 4.296 m. Before 2026-09-28 range was read as 48:13 with x_zero 4096, identical for status-1 objects.
